config.title: UniFi Protect console
config.description: Connect to a UniFi Protect console on the local network. The API key is write-only and is never shown again after saving.

host.label: Console host
host.required: Enter the console host name or IP address
host.invalid: Enter a host name or IP address without scheme, port, path or credentials

apiKey.label: API key
apiKey.placeholder: Enter a new key to replace the configured key
apiKey.invalid: Enter a non-blank API key or remove the replacement

serverName.label: TLS server name
serverName.required: A server name is required when the host is an IP address
serverName.invalid: Enter a DNS name, not an IP address

fingerprint.label: SHA-256 fingerprint
fingerprint.required: Enter the 64-character SHA-256 fingerprint of the certificate

streamHostOverride.label: Stream host override
streamHostOverride.invalid: Enter a host name or IP address without scheme, port, path or credentials

snapshotMinIntervalMs.label: Minimum snapshot interval (ms)
snapshotMinIntervalMs.invalid: Enter a whole number between {min} and {max}

pollIntervalMs.label: Inventory poll interval (ms)
pollIntervalMs.invalid: Enter a whole number between {min} and {max}
